answer: The relation m1 m3/m2^2 = |f|^16/4 does NOT hold exactly at that eps: its true value ranges over 0.463-0.669 (leading order: 0.538).  The headline m1 ~ 1 meV scale and Sigma ~ 59.4-59.8 meV survive, but the phase of eps is a genuine free parameter that moves m1 by up to x1.45 at fixed tau, so the spectrum is not parameter-free and the quoted 0.67-0.97 meV band (attributed to the quark-mass error alone) understates the uncertainty.
